old: Registration requires an 'institute / organization email address' plus either an APAAR ID with faculty endorsement or a DPIIT recognition certificate with a Certificate of Incorporation, so a person with no Indian academic account and no registered company cannot complete step one.
new: Registration requires a name, an 'institute / organization email address' and a mobile number, both verified with an OTP, and then an eligibility ID by category: a Google Scholar ID with h-index, ORCID ID or Scopus Author ID for researchers (h-index of 5 or more), an APAAR ID for UG/PG students, DPIIT recognition for startups, or an Udhyam ID for MSMEs; early-stage startups (3.6) need 4 years of founder experience and an endorsement by the CEO of IndiaAI or a JS rank officer and above.
